d: Battlefield. In the distance the city of Jerusalem. The trumpets announce the presence of the supreme duke, and the Franks, coming out of their respective tents, take sides, making him the military honors. Godfrey appears from his tent, accompanied by a number of primary Paladins.
Preceded and followed by Warriors, among them Eustazio, Armida appears over a cocchio, accompanied by Hydrate under private remains, and by Damasceni and Donzelle.
Paladins and Warriors of all rank, Armida, priors.
Paladini friends of Gernando, Paladini friends of Rinaldo surrounding Goffredo, Warriors, Damasks, Donzelle, and the previous.
Amidst some plants the sea saw. Astarotte and Chorus of Demons, rising below ground.

When the cloud is on the ground, the cloud disappears and presents a cart pulled by two dragons, on which Rinaldo and Armida, who converts the cart into a seat of flowers. Dragons disappear. Rinaldo is almost out of his sight.

Enchanted garden, in which the simple nature has been shown in all its appearance. Plenty of fruit, hedges and bushes full of all sorts of flowers, running waters, other stagnant on which different nozzle veggonsi in motion; other nozzle of bright colors flutter from tree to tree; on one side some caverns covered with moss, the prospect is limited by adjacent hills and shady valleys. Ubaldo, and Carlo.
